title: record_failure shift overflow: 1i64 << attempt panics when attempt >= 63
description: outbox.rs::record_failure computes 1i64 << attempt where attempt is i64 read from DB with no upper bound. If attempt_count >= 63, this panics in debug or produces wrong value in release before the min(_, 3600) clamp applies. Fix: clamp attempt before the shift: let shift = attempt.min(30);
